name: List only uploads belonging to the organization and initiative
fullName: Manage the product CSV lifecycle: List only uploads belonging to the organization and initiative

steps.name: Given the RDB user is authenticated as "producer"
And the RDB initiative is "A"
Given the RDB dataset is "CSV history"
When the producer requests the RDB CSV history
Then the returned RDB upload IDs match the dataset
And the RDB uploads are ordered by date descending
